description: This file contains a script for processing manufacturing stock entries, including reloading documents, filtering work orders, creating stock ledger entries, and reposting stock and valuation entries within an ERP system.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to process stock entries related to manufacturing work orders, including filtering, loading, and reposting stock entries.

methods.name: set_expense_account
methods.description: Sets the expense account for items in a stock entry if not already set.

methods.name: repost_stock_entry
methods.description: Updates and reposts a stock entry and its child items, including creating stock ledger entries.

methods.name: get_sle_for_target_warehouse
methods.description: Generates stock ledger entries for the target warehouse based on stock entry items.

methods.name: repost_future_sle_and_gle
methods.description: Reposts future stock ledger and general ledger entries for a given stock entry document.
